events.title: Proposed ruling: escalate (model confidence 0.85)
events.body:
The rider filed this as a safety incident: she says the driver "kept making comments about my body and asked for my number", and that she "felt harassed and unsafe" [F1][F2 — no, the complaint text is the case fact; ids cited below]. Read as a careful person, that is an allegation of sexual remarks/harassment and of feeling unsafe during the trip, which SAFE-1 (§5.2) requires be escalated regardless of dispute type; the trace confirms SAFE-1 as passed and the only allowed outcome as escalate [SAFE-1].

The record is thin and does not settle the allegation either way. There are no in-app chat messages at all, so nothing the rider or driver said during the trip is captured [F3], and the driver's written statement after the trip — "I made small talk. Nothing inappropriate happened." — is a denial made after the fact, not a contemporaneous record [F4]. The recorded trip data (17.1 km actual vs 17.2 km optimal, 17.0 min vs 23.6 min estimated) contains no time-based corroboration of what happened in the cabin and no audio or call recording; whether any such record exists is not stated in the materials [F1][F2].

Because the complaint alleges harassment and the rider says she felt unsafe, and because the trip generated no chat record of what was said in the vehicle, the outcome turns on evidence the current file does not contain [F3][F4]. Under SAFE-1 the matter goes to a human reviewer, and under SAFE-3 I may only gather and summarise — I do not state fault, and I recommend no outcome, refund or account action.

What the reviewer should check: the full trip record and any call recording or in-app audio flag for the trip; whether any other report has been made about this driver (profile shows 0 disputes and 0 upheld in 90 days, which does not decide this case but is context) [F6][F5]; and the rider's account in her own words, taken in context rather than by keyword [F3][F4].

Confidence is 0.85: the escalation requirement is clear, but the underlying facts are not established on this record — which is precisely why the case must go to a person rather than be ruled on here [SAFE-1][SAFE-3].
